landing.heroTitle: Don’t change the way you work.
landing.heroHighlight: Change what you know about your work.
landing.heroSubtitle: TURI is the AI production-intelligence layer for metalworking shops. It tracks what really happens on your floor, understands why, recommends the next move, and proves the value it created — without adding a single form to your operators’ day.
landing.aiSectionTitle: An AI that knows metalworking, working for you
landing.aiSectionSubtitle: From live shop-floor data to a real assistant — every answer grounded in your own numbers, working to recover capacity and cut loss.
landing.aiCard1Desc: Ask in plain language and get real answers from live data: the bottleneck, the root cause, the order at risk, the next best action.
landing.aiCard2Desc: Value shown as recovered capacity and avoided loss — the profit hiding in downtime and idle hours, surfaced continuously.
landing.aiCard3Desc: Nine weighted factors, scored non-stop, with AI tips on exactly how to raise it and which factor to fix first.
landing.aiCard4Title: Alerts & escalation that fit your shop
landing.aiCard4Desc: Configurable rules for scrap, downtime, late orders, low stock and KPI targets — routed to the right person before it costs you.
landing.aiCard5Title: Live in days, not a year
landing.aiCard5Desc: Kiosk-based and running in minutes. Big touch targets the whole floor uses on day one — no heavyweight rollout.
landing.aiCard6Desc: Encrypted in transit and at rest, role-based access, and a clear data-retention window you own.
landing.ctaBandTitle: Put your shop-floor data to work
landing.ctaBandSubtitle: Start the live demo in seconds — every screen runs on real, continuously-updated data. Then start your 30-day free trial.
landing.footerTagline: AI-powered production intelligence for metal shops
landing.loopTitle: TURI is what its name does
landing.loopSubtitle: Four steps, running continuously — closing the gap between what happens on the floor and what you decide. Every minute, automatically.
landing.loopTrackD: It learns what is happening across every station, order and operator in real time — without asking anyone for a report.
landing.loopUnderstandD: It spots the anomalies, bottlenecks and lost capacity in your data, and finds the root cause behind every delay.
landing.loopRecommendD: It warns you before deadline, capacity, quality and breakdown risks bite — and hands you concrete, do-this-next actions.
landing.loopImproveD: It measures the impact of every action: how much loss was caught, how much capacity was recovered — in money you can see.
landing.qTitle: The questions your floor can’t answer from Excel and WhatsApp
landing.qSubtitle: Today the answers live in spreadsheets, group chats, phone calls and the foreman’s head. TURI answers them from live data — for everyone, all the time.
landing.q1: Where is each job, on whose machine, and how far along?
landing.q2: Which order is about to be late?
landing.q3: Which machine is the bottleneck right now?
landing.q4: Where am I losing capacity — and what is it worth?
landing.q5: Which operator–machine combination actually runs best?
landing.q6: Which orders eat capacity at a thin margin?
landing.q7: Where can I still take cost out?
landing.q8: Where will next week’s problem appear?
landing.q9: What is happening on the floor when you’re not there?
landing.qMotto: Don’t change the way you work — change what you know about your work.
landing.speakEyebrow: It reads the data for you
landing.speakTitle: TURI shows what the company gains — not what the software does
landing.speakSubtitle: No dashboards to decode. TURI turns live data into plain sentences your whole team acts on.
landing.speakGreen: This job is running ahead of plan.
landing.speakTip1: Pull this job forward to cut deadline risk.
landing.speakTip2: Loss on this machine has climbed over the last 3 weeks.
landing.aboutTitle: Born from 70 years on the shop floor
landing.aboutBody1: TURI didn’t start in a software lab. It grew out of the machine and process knowledge of Tusch & Richter — a name that has served metalworking shops for over 70 years, from sheet-metal lines to chip-removing machines.
landing.aboutBody2: TURI is an independent product — not a subsidiary or a reseller arrangement. It simply carries that hard-won understanding of how metal shops really run into a modern AI platform. We were sheet-metal people first, so we know the questions before you ask them — and we build the answers into the product.
landing.aboutGermanTagline: Aus 70 Jahren Erfahrung im Maschinenbau entstanden.
